definitions.adx_14h: ADX(14) via TrendFollowingStrategy._compute_adx over trailing finalized PT1H OHLC (Wilder ewm alpha=1/14, min_periods=14, adjust=False); first 28 bars (2*period) are warmup
definitions.eligibility_rule: ELIGIBLE iff ADX is finite AND ADX < 25.0; otherwise STAND_ASIDE. First warmup_bars=28 bars are always STAND_ASIDE.
